question: Should crawler-scraper/octoparse be split into a hosted record for the MCP template lane and a self-run desktop and CLI record, and which unit adds the hosted record?
why: The hosted lane runs only preset templates on Octoparse cloud nodes through the MCP server (and possibly the AgentTools REST API), with its own allowance (2,000 records a week or a month, by page), its own limits (300 requests a minute per OAuth session, a default allocation of 6 nodes, up to 20 tasks on the help center article against 10 on the pricing table), an account and no card, any MCP client as tooling and MCP as its interface. Free custom-task extraction runs only on the user's own computer, in the desktop application or the npm CLI (the local extraction page: the user's computer supplies the processing, memory, storage, power and network; the cloud resources page lists Free as not included, tasks run locally), and the 50,000 exported rows a month and 10,000 rows per export meter that lane. This unit sets self_hosted true on crawler-scraper/octoparse because its headline allowance is spent on local runs, and orders its text hosted lane first; an add_record needs a discover unit. Proposed record: crawler-scraper/octoparse-mcp, tier MCP template lane, hosted (no self_hosted), identity email, free_tier 2,000 records with the period unverified (unit records once added, else mixed), evidence from the help center article 14593385, the docs pages /mcp and /mcp/rate-limits, the April 2026 release notes and the MCP landing page, with a relate variant_of to crawler-scraper/octoparse. Until it exists the hosted lane is listed only inside the self-run record.
